Delete Ec Vm
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecgroup/:ecgroupId/vm/:vmId

Deletes a VM specified by Cloud or Branch Connector group ID and VM ID.

Request
​

int32
REQUIRED

int32
REQUIRED
